entities.name: Ming–Turpan conflict
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Ming–Turpan conflict were a series of conflicts between the Ming dynasty and Khanate of Moghulistan that erupted due to disputes over borders, trade and internal succession to the throne of Moghulistan.
